_comment: Read by the generic session check: /session-start, /session-end, or
ONLY what the checker cannot auto-detect belongs here. It already finds git, npm test,
gas.json (self-deploying script), tools/clasp-auth.js, tools/tracker-audit.js, tools/canary.js and the GitHub ticket list on its
own. A repo whose tests run via `npm test` can delete the `test` key entirely.
PRESERVE THIS FILE ON UPGRADE. Same rule as build-dashboard.js's CONFIG block: the test command
here is frequently hand-corrected (aac-bill-intake needs an explicit file list because
`node --test gas/` does not work there), and detection cannot reproduce that.
